common.privacyShort: Your input never leaves the browser.

home.title: Developer Tools
home.description: JSON, YAML, Base64, URL, color, JWT, hash, date, and text utilities that keep your data on your device.

workbench.clearDescription: The input and output will be removed from this page. This action cannot be undone.
workbench.privacy: Input, output, secrets and clipboard content stay in this browser. Successful usage stores only a slug and count.
workbench.waitingDescription: Enter content or load the example, then run this tool.
workbench.fixAndRetry: Fix the input and run again. A successful result will appear here.
workbench.invalidInput: The input is invalid. Use the location and guidance below to correct it.
workbench.invalidInputDetail: Check the syntax, required fields, value ranges and encoding, then try again.
workbench.warning: Review the security or format warning associated with this result.
workbench.inputStandard: Input should follow {language} syntax. Only common, unambiguous format issues are repaired; ambiguous content is never guessed.
workbench.jsonHelp: JSON property names and strings require double quotes, for example {example}.

explanation.hex: A hexadecimal color commonly used on the web.
explanation.rgb: Red, green and blue light channels.
explanation.lab: A perceptually uniform color using a D65 white point.
explanation.lch: LAB expressed as lightness, chroma and hue.
explanation.oklab: A color space optimized for visual perception.
explanation.oklch: OKLab expressed as lightness, chroma and hue.
explanation.xyz65: CIE XYZ using a D65 white point.
explanation.xyz50: CIE XYZ using a D50 white point.
explanation.ratio: Relative luminance ratio between foreground and background.
explanation.complementary: Opposite on the color wheel, 180° apart.
explanation.triadicA: The second color in the triadic set.
explanation.triadicB: The third color in the triadic set.
explanation.tetradicA: The second color in the tetradic set.
explanation.tetradicB: The fourth color in the tetradic set.
explanation.monochromaticLight: The same hue with increased lightness.

toolDescription.json-formatter: Format RFC 8259 JSON with selectable indentation and line numbers.
toolDescription.json-minify: Minify JSON without changing its data semantics.
toolDescription.json-validator: Validate RFC 8259 JSON and report its root type.
toolDescription.json-sort-keys: Sort object keys recursively while preserving array order.
toolDescription.json-escape: Convert plain text into JSON string content.
toolDescription.json-unescape: Parse a JSON string literal or escaped content.
toolDescription.json-to-typescript: Infer TypeScript types from JSON with safe unknown fallbacks.
toolDescription.yaml-formatter: Format YAML while preserving common document structures.
toolDescription.yaml-validator: Validate YAML and report syntax errors.
toolDescription.yaml-to-json: Convert YAML values that can be safely represented as JSON.
toolDescription.json-to-yaml: Convert JSON to YAML while preserving array and object order.
toolDescription.ini-conf-formatter: Format INI-style configuration while preserving comments and sections.
toolDescription.ini-conf-validator: Validate INI-style configuration without confusing it with Nginx or Apache syntax.
toolDescription.nginx-conf-formatter: Format Nginx directives, nested blocks and comments.
toolDescription.base64-encode: Encode UTF-8 text as standard Base64 or Base64URL.
toolDescription.base64-decode: Validate Base64 input and decode it as UTF-8.
toolDescription.url-encode: Encode a URL component or preserve the structure of a full URL.
toolDescription.url-decode: Decode URL percent encoding and reject malformed input.
toolDescription.html-entity-encode: Encode HTML-sensitive characters and return plain text.
toolDescription.html-entity-decode: Decode HTML entities without inserting the result into the DOM.
toolDescription.unicode-escape: Convert text into Unicode code point escapes.
toolDescription.unicode-unescape: Parse Unicode escapes, including supplementary code points.
toolDescription.color-converter: Convert CSS colors to HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, XYZ and more.
toolDescription.contrast-checker: Calculate WCAG contrast between foreground and background colors.
toolDescription.palette-generator: Generate complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic and monochromatic palettes.
toolDescription.jwt-decoder: Decode JWT header and payload locally without claiming signature validity.
toolDescription.jwt-expiration-checker: Inspect exp, nbf and iat claims in UTC and local time.
toolDescription.jwt-secret-generator: Generate a cryptographically secure JWT secret of at least 32 bytes.
toolDescription.hash-generator: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 digests.
toolDescription.hmac-generator: Generate HMAC SHA-256 and SHA-512 with explicit key encoding.
toolDescription.random-secret-generator: Generate a random Base64URL, Base64 or HEX secret with Web Crypto.
toolDescription.unix-to-date: Convert Unix seconds or milliseconds to UTC and local dates.
toolDescription.date-to-unix: Convert an ISO date to Unix seconds and milliseconds.
toolDescription.iso-date-formatter: Validate ISO 8601 and display UTC and local representations.
toolDescription.timezone-display: Display the local IANA time zone, UTC offset and current time.
toolDescription.case-converter: Convert text to camel, Pascal, snake, kebab, constant, title and sentence case.
toolDescription.word-character-counter: Count words, characters, graphemes, UTF-8 bytes and lines.
toolDescription.uuid-generator: Generate a cryptographically secure UUID v4.
toolDescription.code-formatter: Format common web, scripting and systems programming languages locally.
toolDescription.code-minifier: Minify JavaScript, JSON, CSS and HTML for deployment.
